title: Xdrip+ isn't responding
symptom: The user reports that xDrip+ shows an 'isn't responding' dialog about every 30 seconds, regardless of which app is in the foreground, even though it works with their Dexcom G5. The graph is empty when the error appears.
fix: A commenter suggests trying to switch off all 'battery optimizations' on the phone, both in the Android settings and under Apps/xdrip+. However, the thread does not confirm that this resolves the issue.
evidence_quote: Try switching off all "battery optimizations" on your phone: 1) search for "battery" in your Androids settings and also check 2) under Apps/xdrip+
